integrity_note: All-parameter proof is analytic; finite exact-rational and floating-point verifications are supporting checks. Originality is assessed against inspected literature with residual historical-coverage risk; no independent external verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only two hubwise price classes on the complete bipartite graph with two hubs and at least three peripheral vertices; it concerns the unnormalized Laplacian spectral gap and does not classify asymmetric optimal edge allocations or discrete-time absolute-spectrum mixing.
title: Exact price-induced spectral-gap transition on \(K_{2,m}\)
